rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Wraps PCILeech hardware-based memory access tool, enabling raw memory read/write operations at any physical address. Provides multi-format memory presentation including hex dump, ASCII view, byte arrays, and DWORD arrays optimized for analysis. Designed for security researchers and reverse engineers examining system memory, analyzing malware, or debugging low-level software with DMA-capable hardware.
